text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
Fufu... Standing here, you can really see 
so many girls, can't you?

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
"Some are chatting, others are walking. 
Some are eating, and some are getting 
ready for their races."

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
That's why I love this place. Watching 
everyone from here... makes my heart boil 
up inside.

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
I will defeat everything that meets my 
eyes. That is why I came here, after all.

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
—What's wrong? ...Of course I don't think 
it'll be easy. However, it's not 
impossible either.

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
I always believe in myself. —"Almond Eye" 
will not lose!
